xref.title: Marine Worm Species
xref.body: A marine worm species, *Grifiela Bidli*, was named after The Beatles. The scientists were reminded of the Beatles' distinctive haircuts by the worm's shaggy fur. "It has Shaggy Fur, which seemed to remind scientists of the Beatles' haircuts."
